success_criteria: A shared target session locator is documented and used by all closure roles.
Desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 screenshots are captured for the same target.
If the target cannot be reached, status is blocked_target_missing rather than PASS/FAIL.
If same-target metrics fail, a product bug is opened against the specific renderer layer.
constraints: No session mutation through APIs or daemon endpoints.

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Conflicting closure evidence for §5.16/§5.17/§5.18: PO PASS vs UI/user unable to find or reach the same samples/cards.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: The immediate root cause is an L5 evidence/closure workflow gap: the PO evidence was tied to a specific seeded session, while UI and user-specialist verification did not have a mandatory same-session locator and therefore searched or reached a different/blocked corpus.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - no source-code regression commit established for this evidence conflict.
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Seeded-session verification was used as closure evidence without promoting the seed route, title/path, sample markers, and pass/fail metrics into a shared closure manifest.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Different specialists can honestly report PASS, BLOCKED, or no verdict depending on which session corpus they can reach, so the spec cannot close reliably.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Cycle 5 had contested §5.16/§5.17/§5.18 conclusions; the current overnight cycle recorded PO PASS evidence and UI/user target-discovery blocks.
observations: observed: product-owner-report.json:86-93 states §5.16 inline/block KaTeX, §5.17 markdown primitives, and §5.18 CronList '{}' inline were visible in a seed session.
observed: ui-specialist-report.json:183-213 states matching_latex_samples_found=0 and matching_cronlist_cards_found=0 in the tested existing sessions.
observed: user-report.json:199-205 states the user-specialist reached authenticated data but could not complete session entry checks after tooling/hook blocks.
observed: local review of po-02-markdown-latex-cron-desktop.png shows the dev-verify-131502 seed session with rendered markdown primitives in the message area.
root_cause_analysis.diagnosis_completeness: complete for closure/evidence classification; incomplete for product-renderer root cause because no same-target failure was observed in this BA pass
root_cause_analysis.localization_evidence: The conflict localizes to the evidence handoff: PO report line 91-93 names rendered target markers in seed session cmoedofgz86n5nz15xsldnk35, while UI report line 189-197 says its opened sessions contained zero matching target markers.

development_approach.strategy: Treat as closure-documentation and test-navigation gap first. Add or update the living spec/evidence manifest so all verifiers open the same seed session and apply the same metrics. Only if same-target metrics fail should a product-renderer bug be opened.
